turns.text: hi can u make me a flashcard layout image for my cranial nerve unit pls
Happy to. A few quick questions so it fits: what should be on the front and back of each card, and do you have any color preferences or a format you're already using?
front is the nerve name + number, back is function and what it innervates. needs to match my notes so green for nerves, pink for muscles and blue for bones

Got it. Here's a layout using your color system:

[Image: A flashcard template shown front and back. Front: a green header bar with "CN __ – Nerve Name" in large text on a white card. Back: a green header strip labeled "Function", a pink box labeled "Muscles innervated", and a blue box labeled "Bones / openings" (for foramina), with a blank line at the bottom for a memory tip.]

Want me to adjust the sizes or add anything?
nice. it has to fit my 600 card anatomy deck tho, i review them on breaks so it cant be too busy

Good point, a break-friendly card should be glanceable. Here's a slimmer version:

[Image: A simplified card, front and back. Front: green banner with a big nerve number and name, lots of white space. Back: three short stacked lines, each with a colored dot, green for function, pink for muscles, blue for bones, one short phrase each, no extra boxes. Small, readable font sized to fit a phone screen.]

Three lines max keeps each card to a few seconds. Should I also make a version with the memory tip line?
no this is good. i skipped the tuesday study group again today so im studying alone, so the cards need to be self contained

Makes sense. For standalone cards, I'd put the key detail directly on the back so you don't need anything else to understand it:

[Image: The same slim card, with the back's three colored lines each filled in with a complete short phrase, e.g. green: "Sensory: smell", pink: "No muscles", blue: "Passes through cribriform plate". A tiny gray footer reads "CN I – Olfactory" so the back identifies itself.]

Now each card carries its own answer and context. I can build the same layout for the other eleven nerves if you paste your list.
yes pls. ok wait i have anatomy tomorrow at 9 so im doing this tonight, and chem is on tuesdays so ill do that after

Okay, to get ready for tomorrow's class, paste your list of the cranial nerves, or just tell me which ones you want first, and I'll fill in all twelve in this layout. Then you can review them before 9 and get to your chem work afterward. Good luck with the unit!
